Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: ONE transparent cinematic spacecraft sprite, StarChain enemy tier 14 "破晓星环旗舰". Preferred canvas 1536x1024.
Primary request: A huge OPEN HALO FLAGSHIP with a large FLAT ANNULAR RING surrounding a long CENTRAL COMMAND-SPEAR HULL aimed LEFT. The ring lies in the SAME HORIZONTAL PLANE as the spear hull, like an open halo around a central spacecraft. Exactly FOUR radial armored bridges connect the command core to the outer ring, leaving FOUR LARGE OPEN TRANSPARENT HOLES between bridges. The ring is a broad flat armored annulus, not a solid saucer. All four quadrant openings should be readable from above and truly transparent. The central elongated spear passes through the middle and projects forward slightly beyond the ring at LEFT. The central spear is narrower than the ring, so the negative space is large and visually important.
Design and materials: a magnificent advanced flagship, densely layered silver-white segmented plate armor over graphite-black machinery; restrained fine panel seams, inset blue command glass along the central hull. Thin violet luminous bands on the INNER EDGE of the ring accentuate the open halo. Four compact substantial rear engine banks sit toward the RIGHT of the central core / rear ring, with short violet emission, no long flame. The ring, four bridges, and central spear form one integrated engineered spaceship.
Orientation and camera: nose LEFT, rear engine banks RIGHT. Cinematic THREE-QUARTER view from moderately ABOVE (about 35 degrees) to make the FLAT horizontal annulus and all four transparent openings clearly visible. The plane of the ring is horizontal, NOT a vertical circular drive ring. Long horizontal overall composition, subtle perspective.
Reference image role: ONLY cinematic realism, silver-white plates, graphite mechanisms, violet-blue accents, precise metallic finish and neutral cool top-left key lighting. DO NOT copy reference fighter geometry.
Framing: completely isolated full spacecraft, all tips and engine effects uncropped. Keep all ship geometry and glow within the central 76 percent width and central 76 percent height of the canvas, with generous clear transparent margins on every edge, at least 8 percent.
Style: premium realistic hard-surface sci-fi game asset, crisp intricate but readable layered construction, convincing weight and grand flagship scale, clean high-quality silhouette.
Background: TRUE transparent RGBA alpha, including all FOUR LARGE OPEN HOLES inside the ring, no background visible through holes, no ground, no ambient haze.
Avoid: solid disc or filled ring interior, vertical ring drive, circular portal standing upright, torus wrapped vertically around fuselage, multiple rings, submarine, naval ship, boat hull, tall city towers or buildings, winged fighter, humanoid robot, humans, extra ships, crop, ground or cast shadow, opaque black background, scene environment, text, numbers, letters, logo, watermark, UI, border, long exhaust trail, laser beams, weapons firing.
